title: #333 Group Work
prompt: It is more important to be able to work with a group of people on a team than to work independently. Do you agree with that?

promptSegments.text: It is more important to be able to work with a group of people on a team than to work independently.

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Teamwork facilitates learning because people can share ideas and collaborate on projects, leading to better results.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Teamwork facilitates learning because people can share ideas and collaborate on projects, leading to better results.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Group work simplifies tasks by allowing individuals to divide the workload, ensuring the entire job is completed efficiently.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Group work simplifies tasks by allowing individuals to divide the workload, ensuring the entire job is completed efficiently.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Working alone gives people a lot of control over their tasks.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Working alone gives people a lot of control over their tasks.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Individual work helps people learn to manage their time well.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Individual work helps people learn to manage their time well.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Teamwork allows individuals to combine knowledge and skills, enabling the division of tasks and leading to stronger outcomes than working alone.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Teamwork allows individuals to combine knowledge and skills, enabling the division of tasks and leading to stronger outcomes than working alone.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Teamwork enhances communication skills and mutual support because members must learn to listen and agree on plans, leading to better acceptance of decisions.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Teamwork enhances communication skills and mutual support because members must learn to listen and agree on plans, leading to better acceptance of decisions.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Working alone gives individuals complete control over their tasks, allowing them to set their own pace and focus deeply, which results in high and consistent quality.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Working alone gives individuals complete control over their tasks, allowing them to set their own pace and focus deeply, which results in high and consistent quality.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Individual work fosters self-reliance and personal skills because people must manage their time and solve problems independently, improving self-discipline and time management.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Individual work fosters self-reliance and personal skills because people must manage their time and solve problems independently, improving self-discipline and time management.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
